tasks.name: Decompose M9 Stefan residuals — per-sensor, per-time-segment, structure
tasks.deliverable: tests/_diagnose_stefan_residuals.py: standalone diagnostic that loads each M9-fitted (x_core, alpha_dough, alpha_crust, rhoL_eff) tuple from tests/baselines/stefan_inverse_research.json, re-runs the forward solver, and decomposes the residual along three axes — per-sensor RMSE, per-time-segment RMSE (startup 0-10%, main 10-90%, tail 90-100%), and residual auto-correlation. Appends a 'Round 2 — residual decomposition (HMS Diamond)' section to tests/baselines/stefan_inverse_research.md with per-fixture tables and a revised verdict. JSON dump at tests/baselines/stefan_inverse_residual_decomposition.json.
tasks.validation_required: Driver runs end-to-end without crashes (~5-10 min wall-clock; no new fits, just forward-solve + slicing on cached parameters). Per-fixture decomposition table appended to research report. Existing M1-M9 tests untouched (this is read-only diagnostic).
